mapper.sql: select t.topic_id, t.account_id, a.account_code, a.account_name, a.platform, t.plan_date, t.slot_no, t.content_kind, t.title, t.angle, t.hook_tool, t.playbook_code, cast(t.program_ids as text) as program_ids, t.source, t.status, t.content_id, t.ai_call_id, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark from abr_topic t left join abr_channel_account a on a.account_id = t.account_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_topic (account_id, plan_date, slot_no, content_kind, title, angle, hook_tool, playbook_code, program_ids, source, status, ai_call_id, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{accountId}, #{planDate}, #{slotNo}, #{contentKind}, #{title}, coalesce(#{angle}, ''), #{hookTool}, #{playbookCode}, cast(coalesce(#{programIds}, '[]') as jsonb), #{source}, coalesce(#{status}, 'planned'), #{aiCallId}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.delete:
delete from abr_topic where content_id is null and topic_id in
#{topicId}
mapper.select: select plan_date as "planDate", count(*) as "count" from abr_topic where account_id = #{accountId} and status <> 'cancelled' and plan_date >= cast(#{from} as date) and plan_date <= cast(#{to} as date) group by plan_date

select content_kind as "contentKind", count(*) as "count" from abr_topic where account_id = #{accountId} and status <> 'cancelled' and plan_date >= cast(#{from} as date) and plan_date <= cast(#{to} as date) group by content_kind
select coalesce(max(slot_no), 0) from abr_topic where account_id = #{accountId} and plan_date = cast(#{planDate} as date) and status <> 'cancelled'

select title from abr_topic where account_id = #{accountId} and status <> 'cancelled' and plan_date >= cast(#{since} as date) union select title from abr_content where account_id = #{accountId} and create_time >= cast(#{since} as date)
mapper.update:
update abr_topic set status = 'cancelled', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now(), remark = '剧本已不再生效，重排' where account_id = #{accountId} and status = 'planned' and content_id is null and source in ('ai', 'backup') and plan_date >= cast(#{from} as date) and playbook_code is not null
and playbook_code not in #{c}
mapper.select: select p.program_id as "programId", s.school_name as "schoolName", p.program_name as "programName", s.country as "country", cast(r.deadlines as text) as "deadlines", greatest(coalesce(p.update_time, p.create_time), coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time)) as "changedTime" from abr_program p join abr_school s on s.school_id = p.school_id and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' left join lateral ( select q.deadlines, q.create_time, q.update_time from abr_requirement q where q.program_id = p.program_id and q.del_flag = '0' and q.status = '0' order by q.season desc, q.requirement_id desc limit 1 ) r on true where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' and p.verified_time >= cast(#{verifiedSince} as date) order by p.program_id
